name: Extreme Cashmere
band_note: mean of sweater entry $400 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13); hand-band
why: One-size, unisex cashmere sweaters, cardigans, dresses, skirts and accessories, mostly $500–$1,400, issued as numbered styles and sold through its own stores and site.

quote.q: extreme cashmere doesn’t follow the traditional fashion cycle, instead we build an ongoing collection suitable for all seasons and all occasions.

opview: “extreme cashmere doesn’t follow the traditional fashion cycle, instead we build an ongoing collection suitable for all seasons and all occasions.” — Extreme Cashmere (house), About, extreme-cashmere.com

facts_read.source: brand site (about, how it began, stores, terms); nordstrom.com search; Vinted catalogue; TRR designer index; B Lab directory; GOTS database

price_read.sublines: extreme cashmere x women's/unisex knitwear and outerwear; EXCLUDED: accessories

doors.note: US: 1 own door, 152 Mercer St, New York 10012. World: 3 (Amsterdam, New York, St. Moritz). No stockist list published. Brand mark is lowercase 'extreme cashmere'.

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 80 of 129 clothing styles (138 feed records less 8 accessories and a comb; one product per style, colours are variants); composition read f

craft_evidence.owned: no — 'production is handled in china'; own team 'on location' with makers, design studio in Amsterdam; no factory owned or named
craft_evidence.mills: no — fibre origin stated as Inner Mongolia, no spinner named
craft_evidence.madein: brand-level only: the quality page says production is in China; 0 of 80 sampled PDPs state a country
craft_evidence.heritage: dated — founded 2016 by Saskia Dijkstra; Amsterdam studio
craft_evidence.process: partial — hand-embroidered flag detail on cuff/hem; fibre from neck and abdomen at moulting; no making process
craft_evidence.reasoning: The quality page states the production country (China), the fibre region (Inner Mongolia) and that the brand keeps its own team on location, but names no maker, mill or spinner and owns nothing. Founding is dated (2016, Saskia Dijkstra). A country and a fibre origin and little else is a 2.
